title: Source-grounded acceptance versus agreement and model self-confidence
paper_track: Beyond the Parser / source-grounded acceptance follow-on
research_question: For frozen document-extraction candidates, does a source-grounded acceptance gate identify a higher-precision accepted subset than candidate agreement or model self-confidence at comparable accepted coverage?
anti_circularity_rule: The source-grounded gate itself is never used as the correctness outcome. Correctness is scored by a separately frozen official or local evaluator/ground-truth contract after candidate outputs and policy features are frozen.
arms: model self-confidence threshold policy when confidence is genuinely emitted by the frozen model/runtime

phase_0.name: zero-GPU frozen-output feasibility
phase_0.eligible_cases: existing frozen public-source candidate outputs for which independent correctness labels/evaluator outputs and source evidence are both already present
required_fields: source revision hash and source locator
agreement features if the agreement arm is evaluated
self-confidence only if emitted by the original frozen runtime
phase_0.missing_data_rule: Never synthesize self-confidence, agreement, or evaluator labels after the fact. An arm with missing original features is reported unavailable rather than imputed.
go_to_phase_1_if: a non-trivial frozen holdout has independent outcome labels
at least two acceptance policies can be evaluated on the same cases without reconstructing missing features
candidate outputs are immutable and policy thresholds are frozen before viewing holdout outcomes

phase_1.design: paired same-candidate acceptance-policy comparison on a held-out public-source cohort
phase_1.primary_endpoint: precision of accepted outputs under the independent correctness outcome
secondary_endpoints: cost per independently correct accepted output
statistics: bootstrap confidence intervals for precision/coverage deltas where sample size permits
stratify by native-text, table, formula, low-quality-scan and other available document families
gpu_economy: if fresh inference is required, generate each candidate once and evaluate all acceptance policies offline
source and evaluator ground truth never mount on GPU workers
prefer 4-way independent sharding only after formal runtime READY

claim_gate.current: A9 native-source gate implemented and unit-verified; empirical precision benefit WITHHELD
claim_gate.success: Only a corpus-scoped statement with denominator, policy thresholds, evaluator revision, confidence interval and immutable receipt hashes may be considered; external publication remains blocked separately by IP/publication controls.
claim_gate.failure: Retain null/negative result and do not tune the registered endpoint after observing holdout outcomes.
